capabilities: Browse daily notes in week, month, and year calendar views with optional image covers
Open or create daily notes for a selected date
Log timestamped quick thoughts into today's note
Summarize words, photos, checked items, and tagged counters into saved Tally reports
View daily notes as a continuous Margin timeline with day names, folded gaps, and linked notes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. Works entirely locally with no analytics or network code; release assets are attested via GitHub Actions. Reference to performance notes suggests further docs elsewhere.
intentEvidence: Use your existing journal folder, date format, and daily-note template
problem: Obsidian's daily notes lack calendar-based navigation over past and future entries and any built-in overview of journaling activity such as word counts or tagged habits.
summary: Calendar plugin that browses daily notes in week, month, and year views, adds timestamped quick logging, and summarizes journal activity with Tally.
